summary: Final run: uv run python analysis.py --final scores heldout once, writes flat cv_auc, holdout_auc, gap
reasoning: The pilot-only estimate is in (cv_auc 0.8854, tuning agreement 0.8852, >= 0.80). The final run with --final reruns exactly the same nested CV (same seed, same code) so cv_auc should stay 0.8854, then selects one configuration among the same eight by 5-fold inner CV on the whole pilot, fits it on all 1000 pilot rows and scores data/heldout.csv (3000 samples) once via decision_function. Expect holdout_auc near the cv estimate: the same generator underlies both files, the configuration sits in a flat plateau (stable), and the final fit uses 25% more training data than the CV folds (training 1000 rows at once vs 800), so the gap should be near zero, within [-0.05, 0.05] on both sides; the other five sealed routes held their agreement, so structural risk is low. The gap is written as the difference of the rounded values so the file is internally exact.
